# A setup that travels with you.
environment = {
  foundation = "nix";
  machines = [
    "macOS" "NixOS" "VMs"
  ];
  profile = "yours";
};

APPLE SILICON

macOS

A declarative development environment alongside the Mac apps you use every day.

  • nix-darwin system configuration
  • Home Manager shell and tools
  • Aerospace window management
  • UTM and QEMU workflows
Explore macOS ↗
NATIVE DESKTOP

NixOS

Own the desktop, the development stack, and the hardware configuration in one place.

  • end4, Omarchy, and KDE Plasma 6
  • Machine-specific hardware modules
  • Optional libvirt host tooling
  • Optional GPU passthrough
Explore NixOS ↗
ROOM TO EXPERIMENT

Virtual machines

Explore a guest environment with dedicated VM modules and platform-aware helpers.
